name: poker-club
description: The Poker Club — a cash-game ledger

scripts.//start: Run the phone app from the repo root. Expo must run inside apps/mobile — started from here it finds no app and hunts for a file called App.
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.//check:ui: The screen half of the gate: builds the app, serves it, holds every route to the handoff rules, measures all 21 sheets on six devices, then plays a big night through and checks no figure is cut off. Needs Playwright. Run it before a merge — see scripts/ui-gate.sh.
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:ui
scripts.//ui: Fonts, web export and a server for scripts/ui-check.mjs — the tool that holds a built screen against the board it was drawn from. Foreground; Ctrl-C stops it. See docs/ui-guide.md.
scripts.//journeys: Play a big night through the built app and check that no figure on any screen is cut off, outside its card, or off the phone. Reaches the screens no URL can — deductions, settle up, who has paid. Needs `npm run ui` running.
scripts.//audit: Re-check every settled night on the server and report the failure rate. Needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY exported in the shell — never written to a file. See docs/verification.md.
